prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for warm human-centered product story. Instruments: electric piano, muted brass, electric bass, snare. 100 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and lively big band jazz track featuring a prominent brass section, walking bass, and drums, creating a cheerful and energetic atmosphere.

description.en: An upbeat and cheerful instrumental track featuring a prominent brass section, lively drums, and a driving bassline. It has a celebratory and slightly retro feel, reminiscent of big band or funk-pop.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的纯音乐，以突出的铜管乐器、活泼的鼓点和有力的贝斯线为特色。它带有一种庆祝和略带复古的感觉，让人联想到大乐队或放克流行乐。
